card.name: Final zero in numbers before mg or msec
card.fires_on: The digit 0 that ends a number just before a metric unit such as msec, ms, mg, mSv or milligrams. Common in QT-interval changes, dose ranges and nutrition facts.

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward metric units like mg, ml and ms, and away from pound, lb and cup.
card.plain: It fires on the last zero of a number when a metric unit like mg or msec comes next.
